New test test_bound_identity_still_refuses_a_component_mismatch drives the override to a component the plan does NOT name and requires the launch to never reach child-bound, so the green arm's identity agreement is evidence rather than tautology

M7.resolution: The home lookup is now LAZY, matching Python: with XDG_DATA_HOME (Linux) or LOCALAPPDATA (Windows) set, the base never consults home, so the port no longer refuses early. That removes the second divergence, making 'exactly one documented divergence' true again. Pinned per-platform in Rust by the_home_lookup_is_lazy_like_pythons; the matrix row is platform-conditional because 'base set, home absent' is structurally unreachable on macOS
